statement: PipeWire's ALSA udev enumerator emits an Audio/Device with api.alsa.path and api.alsa.card when a PCM-capable sound card is present. It populates device.bus-path from udev ID_PATH (falling back to syspath) and separately records device.bus-id from ID_ID, device.bus, sysfs path, vendor/product IDs, serial and optional form factor. These are enumerated sound-card properties, not a built-in join to an independent UHID joystick or a transducer impedance measurement.

applicability.scope: PipeWire SPA ALSA enumerator lines 562-710, host consumer metadata; no source says an independently created PipeWire sidecar is automatically associated with a controller.
